channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: McGuinness planning to rotate players for McKenna Cup final
item.description: Donegal manager Jim McGuinness says he'll probably look to rotate some of his players for Saturday's Dr McKenna Cup final against Monaghan.

item.title: Rouine named new Clare captain
item.description: Cillian Rouine will captain Clare's senior footballers for the 2026 season.

item.title: Kinsella a doubt for Royals' league opener
item.description: Meath could be without key attacker Ruairi Kinsella for their Allianz Football League Division 2 opener against Derry on Saturday week.

item.title: Dominant second-half sees MTU Cork into Fitzgibbon Cup quarter-finals
item.description: MTU Cork moved into the quarter-finals of the Fitzgibbon Cup with home advantage after a seeing off Garda College by 2-20 to 0-13 last night (Thursday).

item.title: Sweeney blow for Tribesmen
item.description: Galway manager Padraic Joyce has been dealt another blow ahead of the 2026 season's start with the news that has opted out of the panel.

item.title: O'Connor's Geelong teammates set to cheer on Dingle in Croker this Sunday
item.description: Three of Mark O'Connor's Geelong Cats teammates are set to be in Croke Park this Sunday to support him and Dingle in the All-Ireland club SFC final.

item.title: "I've been confused watching Cork at times over the last few years" - Cooper
item.description: Kerry great Colm Cooper says he'll be interested to see what Cork will bring to the table this season.

item.title: "At this time of the year, it beats training so we're happy"
item.description: Monaghan captain Micheál Bannigan sees tomorrow's Dr McKenna Cup final against Donegal as "great preparation" for the Farney men's upcoming Allianz League campaign.

item.title: GAA on TV: Five finals to be televised live this weekend
item.description: This weekend sees some pre-season silverware up for grabs along with the All-Ireland club senior football and hurling championship titles.

item.title: "The new rules have been really interesting and exciting to play in"
item.description: Following a difficult inter-county season in 2025, Michele Mann is optimistic Offaly can get themselves back on track in this year's league and championship.
